1.e4 d5 2.d4 dxe4 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Bf5 5..strategy: Kicks the bishop that defends e4 and gains kingside space, but it loosens White's own king's side too. If the bishop gives way, White continues to harass it, since the pawn on e4 depends on it.
Keeps the bishop defending e4 and out of the pawn's reach, so the extra pawn stays. Black has to be ready for the white kingside pawns to keep chasing the bishop, and the doubled f-pawns need care.
